tips.label: to + 原形
tips.text: manage to V、have the ability to V、be keen to V；先看 to 是不定詞符號還是介系詞。

tips.label: 介系詞 + V-ing
tips.text: be keen on、feel like、reward someone for、due to 後若接動作，要用 V-ing。

tips.label: 被動語態
tips.text: 主詞接受動作時，用 be + 過去分詞；先判斷主詞，再配合單複數與時間。

tips.label: 因為
tips.text: because 後接完整子句；because of、due to 後接名詞片語或動名詞。

tips.label: of + 名詞
tips.text: of importance = important；of great importance = very important。

tips.label: 結果發現
tips.text: S + turn out to V，也可以用 It turns out that + 完整子句。

tips.label: reason why
tips.text: why 子句說明原因；主句的動詞仍要跟真正的主詞一致。

notes.title: 不定詞：to 後接原形動詞
notes.rule:
manage to V
have the ability to V
be keen to V
notes.description: manage to V 表示設法成功做到；have the ability to V 表示有能力做；be keen to V 表示渴望做。前面的動詞即使變成過去式，不定詞仍維持 to + 原形動詞。
examples: Kyle managed to complete the task.（Kyle 設法完成了任務。）
She has the ability to detect small changes.（她有能力察覺微小的變化。）
Mia is keen to perform on stage.（Mia 渴望上台表演。）

notes.title: 介系詞後的動名詞
notes.rule:
be keen on + N / V-ing
feel like + N / V-ing
reward someone for + N / V-ing
due to / by + N / V-ing
notes.description: 這些用法中的 on、like、for、to、by 是介系詞。介系詞後可放名詞；若放動作，須改成 V-ing。不要看到 to 就一律接原形：manage to 的 to 與 due to 的 to 功能不同。
examples: Ed is keen on studying animal behavior.（Ed 熱衷於研究動物行為。）
I feel like creating a new game.（我想創造一個新遊戲。）
Sam was rewarded for helping a child.（Sam 因為幫助孩子而獲獎。）
Due to arriving late, he missed the show.（因為遲到，他錯過了表演。）

notes.title: 被動語態與位置表達
notes.rule:
be + 過去分詞
情態助動詞 + be + 過去分詞
have / has + been + 過去分詞
be located + 地點
notes.description: 主詞接受動作時使用被動語態。be 動詞要配合主詞單複數與時間；can、must、will 後的 be 用原形。be assigned to V 表示被指派做某事；be exposed to 表示接觸或暴露於；be infected with 表示感染某疾病。be located 用來描述位於某處。文法題會考形式，不靠猜介系詞。
examples: Mya was assigned to clean the blackboard.（Mya 被指派擦黑板。）
These patients were exposed to dirty water.（這些病人曾接觸髒水。）
Many tasks can be completed by this team.（這個團隊能完成許多任務。）
The task has already been completed.（任務已經完成。）
Al's school is located near the station.（Al 的學校位於車站附近。）

notes.title: because、because of 與 due to
notes.rule:
because + 主詞 + 動詞
because of / due to + 名詞片語或動名詞
notes.description: 三者都能表達原因，差別在後面接的結構。because 後面要有完整子句；because of 與 due to 後面放名詞片語或 V-ing。不能在 due to 後直接放一個帶主詞和動詞的子句。
examples: The performance was canceled because it rained.（因為下雨，表演取消了。）
The performance was canceled because of the rain.（因為這場雨，表演取消了。）
Due to May's carelessness, the project had to be stopped.（因為 May 的疏忽，計畫必須中止。）

notes.title: of + 抽象名詞作補語
notes.rule:
of importance = important
of value = valuable
of use = useful
of interest = interesting
notes.description: of + 抽象名詞可以放在 be 動詞後，表達類似形容詞的意思。of great importance 表示非常重要。of 後需要名詞，因此不是 of important。
examples: Good time management is of great importance.（良好的時間管理非常重要。）
This report is of great value to doctors.（這份報告對醫生很有價值。）
This ability is of great use at work.（這項能力在工作上很有用。）

notes.title: turn out：結果發現
notes.rule:
S + turn out to V
It turns out that + 完整子句
turn out well / badly
notes.description: turn out to V 可表達結果發現某人或某事如何。to 後用原形；若要說結果發現是某種身分或性質，使用 to be。也可改用 It turned out that 引導完整子句。turn out well / badly 表示結果順利或不順利；turned out 是過去式。
examples: Aiden turned out to be the winner.（Aiden 結果是贏家。）
It turned out that Aiden was the winner.（結果發現 Aiden 是贏家。）
The task turned out to need more time.（結果發現這項任務需要更多時間。）
Despite the difficulties, everything turned out well.（儘管遇到困難，結果一切順利。）

notes.title: 關係副詞 why 與主詞一致
notes.rule:
the reason + why + 子句
The reason why ... + 單數動詞
notes.description: why 引導的子句修飾 reason，說明是哪個原因。判斷主句動詞時，要先找真正的主詞：The reason 是單數，不受 why 子句中其他名詞影響。why 子句本身也要有主詞和完整述語。
examples: There wasn't any specific reason why Jason missed the show.（Jason 沒來看表演並沒有什麼特別的原因。）
The reason why she left is still unknown.（她離開的原因仍然不明。）
Nobody knew the reason why the performance was canceled.（沒有人知道表演取消的原因。）

notes.title: 本課搭配補充
notes.rule:
be sensitive to N
suffer from + 疾病
reward someone with N / for N or V-ing
assign someone something = assign something to someone
stay + 形容詞
notes.description: 這些搭配來自字彙頁，作為閱讀與造句補充。sensitive、keen、alert 等形容詞要注意搭配；stay 在 stay alert 中是連綴動詞。未編號的衍生字僅作補充，不另列為本課新單字。
examples: Kelly is sensitive to flavors.（Kelly 對味道敏感。）
The teacher rewarded Ed with a small prize.（老師用小獎品獎勵 Ed。）
The teacher assigned a task to Mya.（老師指派一項任務給 Mya。）
Please stay alert during the experiment.（實驗進行時請保持警覺。）

quiz.question: Kyle managed ___ all his tasks before dinner.
quiz.hint: manage 後接 to + 原形動詞，表示設法成功做到，所以用 to complete。

quiz.question: Our team has the ability ___ new computer games.
quiz.hint: have the ability to V 表示有能力做某事；to 後用原形 create。

quiz.question: Nina is keen ___ at the school show next month.
quiz.hint: be keen to V 表示渴望做某事，此處需要 to perform。

quiz.question: The students were assigned ___ an experiment tomorrow.
quiz.hint: be assigned to V 表示被指派做某事；不定詞用 to carry out。

quiz.question: We managed ___ the missing item before the store closed.
quiz.hint: managed 後要接 to + 原形動詞；過去時間已由 managed 表示，不把 locate 改成過去式。

quiz.question: Ed is keen ___ new ways to prevent disease.
quiz.hint: 本句用 be keen to V，表示渴望學習，所以選 to learn。

quiz.question: Lily has the ability ___ small changes in temperature.
quiz.hint: ability 後的不定詞說明是哪一種能力，結構是 the ability to detect。

quiz.question: The doctor managed ___ all the patients before noon.
quiz.hint: manage to V 表示設法成功做到；即使 managed 是過去式，to 後仍用原形 treat。

quiz.question: Sam is keen on ___ songs for his friends.
quiz.hint: 這裡有介系詞 on；介系詞後的動詞要用 V-ing，所以選 performing。

quiz.question: I feel like ___ a new game tonight.
quiz.hint: feel like 表示想要，這裡的 like 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 creating。

quiz.question: Jack was rewarded for ___ a lost child find her parents.
quiz.hint: for 是介系詞，後面接動名詞；helping a lost child 說明獲獎的原因。

quiz.question: Due to ___ late, Maya missed the start of her assigned task.
quiz.hint: due to 的 to 是介系詞，後面可接名詞或 V-ing，因此選 arriving。

quiz.question: By ___ these articles, students can learn about different opinions.
quiz.hint: by 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用動名詞 reading，表示透過閱讀這個方法。

quiz.question: Zoe is keen on ___ how animals behave.
quiz.hint: be keen on 後接名詞或 V-ing，所以使用 studying。

quiz.question: They do not feel like ___ the outdoor show in such heavy rain.
quiz.hint: feel like 後接動名詞，否定詞 do not 不會改變這個搭配的文法，因此選 attending。

quiz.question: Nick was rewarded for ___ the experiment on time.
quiz.hint: for 後需要動名詞，completing the experiment 表示完成實驗這件事。

quiz.question: Yesterday, each student ___ a special task by the teacher.
quiz.hint: by the teacher 表示學生接受指派，要用被動；Yesterday 指過去，each student 為單數，所以選 was assigned。

quiz.question: New ideas ___ by the team members every Friday.
quiz.hint: ideas 是被創造出來的，須用被動；New ideas 為複數，every Friday 表示習慣，所以選 are created。

quiz.question: Next Monday, the workers ___ to the new safety methods for the first time.
quiz.hint: Next Monday 指未來；workers 將接觸到新方法，使用 will be + 過去分詞的被動形式。

quiz.question: The new library ___ near the train station.
quiz.hint: 表達某建築物位於某處，用 be located；The new library 為單數，選 is located。

quiz.question: After helping patients last week, Ed ___ with a prize by the hospital.
quiz.hint: Ed 是接受獎勵的人，by the hospital 指出施事者；last week 指過去，所以用 was rewarded。

quiz.question: Many tasks can ___ by this new machine.
quiz.hint: by this new machine 指出完成任務的施事者，tasks 是被完成的；can 後的被動結構為 be + 過去分詞，因此選 be completed。

quiz.question: Children who are exposed to strong sunlight must ___ by an adult.
quiz.hint: children 是受到保護的人，且有 by an adult；must 後的被動形式是 be protected。

quiz.question: These two items ___ to our group yesterday.
quiz.hint: items 接受分配，須用被動；These two items 為複數，yesterday 指過去，所以用 were assigned。

quiz.question: The task has already ___ by our team.
quiz.hint: has already 提示現在完成式，by our team 提示被動；完整結構為 has been completed。

quiz.question: An investigation will ___ by the police tomorrow.
quiz.hint: investigation 是被執行的，will 後要接 be + 過去分詞，所以用 be carried out。

quiz.question: Because it ___ heavily last night, the performance was canceled.
quiz.hint: because 後接完整子句，需要有限動詞；last night 指過去，所以選 rained。

quiz.question: ___ the road was closed, we could not carry out the task.
quiz.hint: 空格後是 the road was closed 這個完整子句，因此用連接詞 Because；其餘三項後接名詞或動名詞。

quiz.question: The outdoor performance was stopped ___ heavy rain.
quiz.hint: heavy rain 是名詞片語，因此選可接名詞的 due to；because、although、when 後需要子句。

quiz.question: Mia stayed home because ___.
quiz.hint: because 是連接詞，後面要有主詞和動詞；只有 she was ill 是完整子句。

quiz.question: Due to ___, several players missed the game.
quiz.hint: due to 後接名詞片語，a serious disease 符合；其餘選項都有主詞和動詞，是子句。

quiz.question: Because of ___, the team could not perform on stage.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語；the storm 是名詞片語，另外三項都是完整子句。

quiz.question: Because the patient ___, the doctor kept him in the hospital.
quiz.hint: because 後要有完整子句；the patient 後用 was infected 作述語，表示病人遭感染。

quiz.question: Due to ___, we canceled the outdoor performance.
quiz.hint: due to 後接名詞片語，所以選 the heavy rain；其他選項都有自己的主詞和動詞。

quiz.question: Good time management is of great ___.
quiz.hint: of great 後需要名詞，importance 是名詞；of great importance 表示非常重要。

quiz.question: This new report about disease is of great ___ to doctors.
quiz.hint: of great + 抽象名詞可以作補語，value 是名詞；valuable 是形容詞。

quiz.question: This ability is of great ___ in an emergency.
quiz.hint: of great 後需要抽象名詞，use 在這裡是名詞，of great use 表示非常有用。

quiz.question: The results of this study are of great ___.
quiz.hint: of great 後接名詞 interest；interesting、interested 是形容詞，interestingly 是副詞。

quiz.question: The lost item turned out ___ a key.
quiz.hint: turned out to be 用來說明最後發現的身分或性質；這裡要用不定詞 to be。

quiz.question: The boy turned out ___ the ability to detect faint sounds.
quiz.hint: S + turned out to V 表示結果發現某人如何；to 後接原形 have。

quiz.question: It turned out ___ the man was a doctor.
quiz.hint: It turned out that + 完整子句表示結果發現……；the man was a doctor 已完整，使用 that 引導。

quiz.question: The plan turned out ___ more time than we expected.
quiz.hint: turned out 後可接 to + 原形動詞，所以選 to need，表示結果發現需要更多時間。

quiz.question: The winner turned out ___ my classmate.
quiz.hint: 要說結果發現得獎者是我的同學，使用 turned out to be + 名詞。

quiz.question: It turned out that the missing items ___ in a box.
quiz.hint: that 子句仍須有完整述語；the missing items 是複數，且是在敘述過去發現的結果，所以用 were。

quiz.question: The task turned out ___ harder than we expected.
quiz.hint: turned out to be + 形容詞表示結果發現具有某種性質，這裡選 to be。

quiz.question: It turned out that both children ___ infected.
quiz.hint: both children 是複數；子句要用過去式 be 動詞 were，與 infected 構成完整述語。

quiz.question: Nobody knew the reason ___ the performance was stopped.
quiz.hint: 先行詞是 the reason，後面的子句說明原因，並未缺主詞或受詞，所以用關係副詞 why。

quiz.question: Can you explain the reason ___ Nina feels so sensitive about this subject?
quiz.hint: the reason 後面的子句解釋原因，使用 why；where 指地點，who、whose 指人或所有關係。

quiz.question: The reason why she missed the performance ___ still unknown.
quiz.hint: 主詞是單數 The reason；why 子句只是修飾 reason，因此主要動詞用 is。

quiz.question: There are two reasons why the scientist ___ these items carefully every day.
quiz.hint: why 子句中 the scientist 是第三人稱單數，every day 表示習慣性動作，所以選 checks。

vocab.sentence_chinese: 她有能力解決這個問題。

vocab.sentence: The teacher predicted that our team would win.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 老師預測我們隊會獲勝。

vocab.sentence: Kyle managed to lose twenty pounds.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Kyle 成功減掉了二十磅。

vocab.sentence: The students created a new game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 學生們創造了一個新遊戲。

vocab.sentence: By reading these articles, students will be exposed to different opinions about the topic.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 透過閱讀這些文章，學生將接觸到關於這個主題的不同意見。

vocab.sentence: Brad performed a song as a creative way to ask Jennifer to marry him.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Brad 演唱了一首歌，以創意的方式向 Jennifer 求婚。

vocab.sentence: Animal behavior can tell us a lot about what a creature is thinking about or wants.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 動物的行為能讓我們了解牠正在想什麼或想要什麼。

vocab.sentence: The little beeps that your phone makes help you stay alert to new emails, messages, and posts.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 手機發出的短促提示聲，能幫助你留意新的電子郵件、訊息和貼文。

vocab.sentence: In this English literature course, we will study the complete works of Shakespeare.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在這門英國文學課程中，我們將研讀莎士比亞的作品全集。

vocab.sentence: Mya was assigned to clean the blackboard.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Mya 被指派去擦黑板。

vocab.sentence: Can you be more specific about what you need?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你能更明確地說明你的需求嗎？

phrases.sentence: Due to May's carelessness, the project had to be stopped.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 因為 May 的疏忽，這項計畫必須中止。

phrases.sentence: All of a sudden, it began to rain.
Despite all the difficulties, everything turned out well.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 儘管遇到種種困難，結果一切順利。

phrases.sentence: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我打掃房間時，偶然發現了一張舊照片。

phrases.sentence: The police carried out an investigation.

grammar.sentence: We managed to locate all the missing items.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們設法找到了所有遺失的物品。

grammar.sentence: Ed is keen on studying animal behavior.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Ed 熱衷於研究動物行為。

grammar.sentence: The students were assigned to clean the room.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 學生們被指派去打掃房間。

grammar.sentence: The performance was canceled because it rained heavily.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為下大雨，表演取消了。

grammar.sentence: Good time management is of great importance.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 良好的時間管理非常重要。

grammar.sentence: The missing item turned out to be a key.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那件遺失的物品結果是一把鑰匙。

grammar.sentence: Nobody knew the reason why the performance was canceled.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 沒有人知道表演取消的原因。

grammar.sentence: The boy has the ability to detect sounds.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這個男孩有能力偵測聲音。

grammar.sentence: I feel like creating a new game.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想創造一個新遊戲。

grammar.sentence: These patients were exposed to dirty water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些病人曾接觸髒水。

grammar.sentence: Because of the rain, we stayed at home.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為這場雨，我們待在家裡。

grammar.sentence: This report is of great value to doctors.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這份報告對醫生很有價值。

grammar.sentence: The man turned out to be our new manager.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個男人結果是我們的新經理。

grammar.sentence: Tell me the reason why you chose this item.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 告訴我你選擇這件物品的原因。

grammar.sentence: Mia is keen to perform at the show.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Mia 渴望在這場表演中演出。

grammar.sentence: Sam was rewarded for helping an infected child.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Sam 因為幫助一名遭感染的孩子而獲獎。

grammar.sentence: The man was infected with a serious disease.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這個男人感染了一種嚴重的疾病。

grammar.sentence: Due to illness, he missed the performance yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為生病，他錯過了昨天的表演。

grammar.sentence: The new study is of interest to scientists.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這項新研究令科學家感興趣。

grammar.sentence: It turned out that the patient was infected.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 結果發現那位病人遭到了感染。

grammar.sentence: The reason why he left is still unknown.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他離開的原因仍然不明。

grammar.sentence: They managed to complete the task before dinner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們設法在晚餐前完成了任務。

grammar.sentence: She is keen on reading about this disease.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她熱衷於閱讀關於這種疾病的資料。

grammar.sentence: Each item must be checked before the show.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 每件物品都必須在表演前檢查。

grammar.sentence: We left early because the task was complete.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為任務已完成，我們提早離開。

grammar.sentence: This ability is of great use at work.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這項能力在工作上很有用。

grammar.sentence: The task turned out to be quite easy.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那項任務結果相當容易。

grammar.sentence: The task has already been completed by our team.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這項任務已由我們隊完成。

grammar.sentence: Everything turned out well after we changed the plan.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們改變計畫後，結果一切順利。

grammar.sentence: The missing dog was located near the station.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那隻走失的狗在車站附近被找到了。

cloze_quiz.question: Even a tiny amount of pepper makes Mia's mouth hurt. She is very ___ to spicy food.
cloze_quiz.hint: a tiny amount of pepper 就讓嘴巴痛，且句型為 sensitive to，表示對辣食敏感。specific 是特定或明確的，不能表示對辣食的敏感反應。

cloze_quiz.question: Leo is ___ on learning about animals; he reads animal books eagerly every day.
cloze_quiz.hint: eagerly every day 表示積極熱衷，be keen on 表示熱衷於。infected 表示遭感染，不能用 infected on learning 描述熱衷學習。

cloze_quiz.question: A smoke alarm uses a sensor to ___ smoke in the air and then sounds a warning.
cloze_quiz.hint: smoke alarm、sensor 和 sounds a warning 說明感應器先偵測煙霧，再發出警報，所以用 detect。perform 是執行或表演，不能表示感應器偵測煙霧。

cloze_quiz.question: The shopping list has just one ___ on it: a bottle of milk.
cloze_quiz.hint: 清單上列的是 a bottle of milk 這件物品，因此用 item。ability 是能力，不能指清單上的一瓶牛奶。

cloze_quiz.question: Our final goal is to finish building the bridge. With one more day of work, we can ___ this goal.
cloze_quiz.hint: finish building 和 one more day of work 說明工作即將完成、目標即將達成，所以用 accomplish。locate 是找到位置，不是達成已明確說出的目標。

cloze_quiz.question: The flu is a ___ caused by a virus, and it can make people cough and have a fever.
cloze_quiz.hint: virus、cough 和 fever 都是疾病相關線索，所以用 disease。performance 是表演或表現，不能表示病毒引起的疾病。

cloze_quiz.question: The wound contains harmful bacteria and needs medical treatment because it has become ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 傷口有 harmful bacteria，並需要醫療處理，說明傷口已遭感染，所以用 infected。alert 是警覺的，不能形容傷口因細菌而需要治療。

cloze_quiz.question: The rescue team's only task is to find where the lost hikers are. They use the hikers' phone signal to ___ them.
cloze_quiz.hint: only task is to find where 明確說要找出登山客的位置，所以用 locate。reward 是獎勵，無法完成題幹指定的尋人任務。

cloze_quiz.question: The town offered a $500 ___ to anyone who returned the missing dog safely.
cloze_quiz.hint: $500 和 returned the missing dog safely 表示給找回狗的人五百元報酬，所以用 reward。ability 是能力，不能表示提供給尋獲者的金錢報酬。

cloze_quiz.question: This bird has the ___ to copy human speech; it can clearly say several words.
cloze_quiz.hint: can clearly say several words 證明鳥有模仿人聲的能力，所以用 ability。reward 是因行為得到的獎勵，不能表示鳥會說話這種本領。

cloze_quiz.question: Before tomorrow's storm arrives, weather experts study the clouds to ___ when it will begin.
cloze_quiz.hint: Before tomorrow's storm 和 when it will begin 指向尚未發生的事情，需要預測，所以用 predict。expose 是使接觸或暴露，不能表示推估暴風雨開始的時間。

cloze_quiz.question: The twins have only $100 for the whole week, so they must ___ their money carefully to make it last.
cloze_quiz.hint: only $100、whole week 和 make it last 說明要妥善管理預算，所以用 manage。locate 只是找出位置，不能讓這筆錢足夠使用一週。

cloze_quiz.question: This page is blank. Use your imagination to ___ a brand-new character that has never existed before.
cloze_quiz.hint: blank、imagination 和 never existed before 說明要從無到有創造角色，所以用 create。locate 和 detect 都是找到或察覺既有事物。

cloze_quiz.question: Please close the curtain so sunlight cannot reach the old painting. Leaving it open would ___ the painting to direct sunlight.
cloze_quiz.hint: Leaving it open 會使陽光照到畫作，expose the painting to sunlight 表示使畫作暴露於日光。assign 是指派，不能表示讓畫作受到日照。

cloze_quiz.question: The band will ___ three songs on stage for the audience tonight.
cloze_quiz.hint: band、three songs、on stage 和 audience 明確構成演出情境，所以用 perform。assign 是分配任務，不能用 assign songs on stage for the audience 表示樂團演唱。

cloze_quiz.question: A person's actions, such as sharing with others or shouting in class, are called their ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: actions 加上分享、上課叫喊等具體行動，說明問的是行為，所以用 behavior。ability 指能做什麼的能力，並不是已做出的行動本身。

cloze_quiz.question: The weather office sent a storm ___ to warn people that strong winds were coming.
cloze_quiz.hint: to warn people 和 strong winds were coming 說明氣象單位發布警示，所以用 alert。reward 是獎勵，不能表示天氣危險通知。

cloze_quiz.question: Only nine of the ten questions are answered, so the homework is not yet ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 十題只答完九題，仍有未完成部分，所以用 complete。sensitive 是敏感的，不能表示作業是否完成。

cloze_quiz.question: The teacher has ten different tasks ready. She will ___ one task to each student, so everyone knows which job to do.
cloze_quiz.hint: one task to each student 與 which job to do 說明老師要分派任務，所以用 assign。perform 表示執行任務，不能表示把任務分配給每位學生。

cloze_quiz.question: Do not just tell me "somewhere in Kaohsiung." Please give me a ___ address, including the street name and house number.
cloze_quiz.hint: street name 和 house number 要求明確地址，因此選 specific。keen 是敏銳或熱衷的，不能形容地址的明確程度。
